name: lifeboard
description: Personal life dashboard. TypeScript in src/ bundled by esbuild to dist/; legacy root JS still loads as plain scripts. Scripts wrap the checks in tools/.

scripts.bootstrap: corepack enable && pnpm install && pnpm exec playwright install chromium
scripts.test: vitest run && node tools/spec-check.js && node sim/run.js 20 8 > /dev/null
